sources.snippet: This work presents Video Depth Anything based on Depth Anything V2, which can be applied to arbitrarily long videos without compromising quality, consistency, or generalization ability. Compared with other diffusion-based models, it enjoys faster inference speed, fewer parameters, and higher consistent depth accuracy.
